description: This Java class 'DatatableWriteServiceImpl' implements the 'DatatableWriteService' interface. It provides methods for managing dynamic data tables within the application, including creation, updating, and deletion of data tables and their entries. It handles database schema operations like creating tables, adding/modifying/dropping columns, managing constraints and indexes, as well as registering/deregistering tables in internal registries. It also manages permission setup for data tables and validates schema modifications. The class uses Spring's transaction management and interacts with the database via JdbcTemplate. It is part of the Fineract platform and appears core to handling dynamic data structures within the system.

classes.name: DatatableWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the 'DatatableWriteService' interface, managing creation, updating, deletion of data tables and their entries in the Fineract platform, including schema modifications and permissions management.

methods.name: registerDatatable
methods.description: Registers a new data table in the system with specified parameters, including permissions setup.

methods.name: deregisterDatatable
methods.description: Removes a data table registration and its associated permissions and configurations from the system.

methods.name: createDatatable
methods.description: Creates a new data table with structure based on provided JSON definition, including columns, keys, and constraints.

methods.name: updateDatatable
methods.description: Alters the schema of an existing data table by adding, removing, or modifying columns and constraints.

methods.name: deleteDatatable
methods.description: Deletes a data table from the database after ensuring it is empty.

methods.name: createNewDatatableEntry
methods.description: Creates a new record in the specified data table.

methods.name: createPPIEntry
methods.description: Creates a new personal data entry with PPI considerations.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOneToOne
methods.description: Updates an existing data table entry with a one-to-one relationship.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOneToMany
methods.description: Updates or adds entries with a one-to-many relationship.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple entries from a data table.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntry
methods.description: Deletes a single data table entry.
